description: Read one repair guide's full Markdown steps by exact slug. Use search_repair_guides instead to find slugs by model, component, or words. Returns steps with manual page citations, the official manual URL, service classification, and scope restrictions (typically 2 to 17 KB). Slug match ignores case and surrounding spaces; an unknown slug is an error result — call search_repair_guides. Not bench-tested; follow the scope restrictions and the OEM manual.

slug.description: Required. Guide slug from search_repair_guides, e.g. "hp-elitebook-840-g6-battery-replacement".

name: get_repair_guide

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

title: Get a repair guide
